title: Replace Words: A Stenographer's Shorthand
summary: Each word walks a trie of stems and stops at the first stem that ends, which is the shortest one.

analogy.scenario: A stenographer writes each word as its shortest stem from a list (re, for, form, un) and words with no stem in full: "they reran the format unchanged".

takeaway.summary: Put the roots in a trie. Each word walks it and stops at the first node that ends a root (the shortest root); a missing child means the word stays as it is.

scenes.narration: A stenographer has the stems re, for, form, and un. Each word becomes its shortest stem, or stays whole if none fits: they reran the format unchanged.
scenes.caption: Stems re, for, form, un: shorten "they reran the format unchanged"

scenes.narration: Testing every stem against every word repeats the same letters over and over. A trie checks all stems at once, one letter at a time.
scenes.caption: Checking every stem against every word repeats the work

scenes.narration: Put the stems in a trie. For and form share f, o, r, and each stem's last letter is marked.
scenes.caption: The stems in a trie: for and form share f, o, r

scenes.narration: They: the root has no t, so no stem fits and the word stays whole.
scenes.caption: they: no t at the root, so it stays whole

scenes.narration: Reran walks r, e, and e ends a stem: write re.
scenes.caption: reran: r, e ends a stem: re

scenes.narration: The: again no t at the root, so it stays whole.
scenes.caption: the: no t again, stays whole

scenes.narration: Format walks f, o, r, and r already ends a stem. The walk stops at the first stem it reaches, so the shortest one wins: for, not form.
scenes.caption: format stops at for, the first stem it reaches

scenes.narration: Unchanged walks u, n, which ends a stem: un.
scenes.caption: unchanged: u, n ends a stem: un

scenes.narration: Stems are roots in a trie. Each word walks it and stops at the first root's end, the shortest root, or stays whole when a letter is missing.
scenes.caption: Walk each word; stop at the first root's end
